usage: The word "種" (zung2) is used as a measure word for different kinds or types of things.
When you want to classify items by their categories, you use "種" before the noun.
It can also be used as a noun to mean "type" or "kind" directly.
In a sentence, "種" typically comes after a number or a demonstrative pronoun (like "呢"/this) to specify the type of something.
It helps to talk about diversity or variation within a group of objects or concepts.
